Three Wrenfield emails (email:deb7de95, email:d62b3834, email:060bebce) got no reply, and no tickets filed, so there's no sign of engagement. Starter plan, 8 days left; unaided activation looks unlikely but not impossible.

draft.subject: One step to get Summit Analytics started
draft.body:
Hi Ben,

I don't want to crowd your inbox, so this is my last nudge for now. Nothing's set up on Summit Analytics yet, and the usual first step is simple: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating one project gets things moving. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

If it's easier, I'm happy to walk through that first project with you on a 15-minute call this week -- just reply with a time that suits and I'll send an invite.

Best,
Chidi
